## Summary

Phase 4 (Architecture-judgment domains) is complete: **[PR #44](https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/44)**

Delivered the shared bounded-context/layer-boundary map plus all 3 architecture domains (`ddd`, `clean-architecture`, `enterprise-architecture`) via real dependency-cruiser rules and a live AI Review drift-check — 10 lint findings + 5 judgment findings, all real and idempotent, closed out in the plan file via a script-generated evidence block matching the established Phase 2/3 convention.

Two real bugs were caught and fixed during live smoke-testing before trusting any evidence: a silent-zero-files dependency-cruiser/TypeScript resolution gap, and a backwards layer-ordering assumption that would have flagged a legitimate import pattern as a false violation.

Both SUCCESS_CRITERIA are verified working (`query-knowledge` returns 7 rows; phase-4 status updated in the plan file), and the plan file's own `depends_on`/status mechanism should let `auto_phase_continuation.py` pick up Phase 5 automatically once this PR merges.
